answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining the market garden of services, with the stake locked for a cooling period. Each new identity enters through a single narrow inlet: a verified proof-of-work or proof-of-stake bond tied to one hardware or payment credential, so one operator cannot cheaply spawn thousands. If an agent misbehaves, peers slash the stake and the penalty ripples through its reputation graph, raising the cost of the next fake identity until creating sock puppets costs more than the fraud it enables.
